questions.question: What did Tsurugi learn about his father from Gojo clan members?
questions.subject: Tsurugi Okkotsu/Synopsis

answer.item: By secretly asking some prominent Gojo Clan members, he eventually learned that his father had a dignified nature, but hated the weakness of the current generation of jujutsu sorcerers compared to his parents'.

questions.question: Who gave Tsurugi his ring when he was eleven?
questions.subject: Tsurugi Okkotsu/Synopsis

answer.item: At age 11, his mother Mifuyu gave him the ring.
